summary: Small tree-shaded riverside bay with cars already parked, no homes.
reasons: Only a small non-dwelling building 41 m away
Trees around and cars already parked

drivers.seclusion: Trees and river bank around; no dwellings in range.
drivers.access_and_room: Opens straight onto the sealed car park; several vehicles already fit inside the bay.
drivers.traffic: Quiet one-way riverside road passes about 20 m north.
drivers.convention: Public free car park (access yes, fee no) with cars parked in the bay.

flags: Low-lying: about 8 m elevation, 84 m from the Brisbane River
Mapped gate 197 m away has a way round
sun_shade: Tree canopy shades the east and south sides; open to the north.
cannot_judge: Room if the bay is full

best_section.where: Small bay beside the riverside car park off Meiers Road, under the trees
